author: bardic-inspiration
name: Dewpetal Fawn
summary: A speckled fawn whose hooves leave small flowers that open at dawn and close by noon.
description: Forest folk say a dewpetal fawn means a glade is safe to sleep in. The fawn is shy and quick to bolt, but it will nose at a wounded traveler if nothing else is around, and the flowers it leaves are good for poultices.

traits.name: Bloom Trail
traits.text: Each space the fawn moves through becomes a patch of blooming flowers until the next dawn. A creature that starts its turn in a patch of blooms has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against being {ref:condition/frightened}.

bonusActions.name: Healing Dew
bonusActions.text: The fawn touches one creature within 5 feet of it. The target regains 1d8 {ref:glossary/hit-points} and ends the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition on itself.
